*Last updated 5 September 2026.*

Discover ("the app") is published by Rodolphe Cambier. It follows your position while you drive and talks
about the places you pass. It has no account, no server of its own, no analytics and no advertising. Nothing
you do in the app is sent to us.

## What leaves your phone, and where it goes

| Data | Sent to | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Your position (coordinates) | Apple (reverse geocoding), Wikipedia and Wikivoyage (Wikimedia Foundation) | To name the town you are in and find the places around you. |
| Where you are, in words: town, region, country, direction and speed. Names and short descriptions of nearby places. | OpenAI | So the guide knows what to talk about. Exact coordinates are sent only when the town cannot be named. |
| Your voice, while the talk button is held and for a few seconds after the guide finishes speaking | OpenAI | To answer your question. The app does not record or store audio. |
| Your OpenAI key | OpenAI only | To pay for the voice with your own OpenAI account. |

OpenAI processes this data under its own [privacy policy](https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy) and
[API data usage policies](https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage-policies). Wikimedia's policy is
[here](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Privacy_policy). Apple's map and geocoding services are
covered by Apple's [privacy policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).

## What stays on your phone

- Your OpenAI key, in the iPhone Keychain. The app shows only its last four characters after you save it.
- Your settings: special interests, narrator, language, pace, chattiness, voice model.
- An estimate of what each day of driving cost, computed from the token counts OpenAI reports. Kept for 31 days.

Deleting the app deletes all of it.

## Location in the background

Discover keeps following your position with the screen locked, so it can keep narrating. Location is used
only while a trip is running. The app does not build a history of where you have been.

## Children

The app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from them.

## Changes

Changes to this policy are published on this page with a new date.
